lat.en: Present: the action has begun and is not yet finished; also habit and general truth. By 3.3.131 it may also stand for the just-past or the about-to-happen.

lan.en: Past, not of today: the action happened on an earlier day.

lit.en: Past, not of today and out of the speaker's sight (परोक्ष) — usually long ago; the tense of narrative and history.

lun.en: Past in general: at any past time, today included.

lrt.en: Future in general: at any future time, today included.

lut.en: Future, not of today: on a later day.

lot.en: Command, request, invitation, permission; also blessing.

vidhilin.sa: विधिः, निमन्त्रणम्, आमन्त्रणम्, अधीष्टम्, सम्प्रश्नः, प्रार्थना; सम्भावना
vidhilin.en: Injunction (should), invitation, permission, polite request, a question of what to do, prayer; also possibility (may, might).

asirlin.en: Blessing or wish: may it be so.

lrn.en: Conditional: the cause of the action was there but the action did not happen — 'if … had …, … would have …'; for past or future.
